label: Fisher / Emerson Control Valve Handbook 5th ed. (D101881X012/Sept19)
notes: Freely published by the manufacturer. Emerson's own document URL now serves a landing page rather than the file, and the live PDF path carries the SIXTH edition (17 MB), so the archived fifth edition came from a public web copy and is pinned by the hash in this row. Source of the equation constants, the FL/xT/Fd style table and three worked examples. A secondary source, cited as one everywhere it is used. Re-checking the transcription against the 6th edition is open work.

label: IEC 60534-2-1:1998 Part 2-1 Flow capacity sizing equations (national-body adoption of the first edition)
notes: The primary source the Fisher handbook reproduces. IEC sells the current (2011) edition at the registry URL above; the copy read here is the 1998 first edition as adopted and republished by a national standards body, obtained as a public web copy and pinned by hash. A scan: its tables and numbers extract cleanly, its equations do not. Supplied the four annex worked examples and the normative equation structure in clause 7.1.2.2 that settles the Y-with-xTP question.

label: Masoneilan Control Valve Sizing Handbook (Baker Hughes)
notes: Publisher's own CDN. A second manufacturer's independent transcription of the same ISA/IEC tables, used as corroboration: it prints the same N1, N2 and N6 metric rows the engine carries. Also publishes N4 = 76000 and confirms the ISA-RP75.23 sigma definition.

label: SAMSON Technical Information Part 3: Cavitation in Control Valves
notes: Publisher's own site. Confirms that SAMSON's xFZ = (p1-p2)/(p1-pV) is the exact reciprocal of the sigma this tool reports, which is the inverted-convention trap the cavitation panel warns about. Publishes no xFZ values by valve style.

label: SAMSON Application Notes: KV coefficient and valve sizing
notes: Publisher's own site. Simplified Kv equations that explicitly exclude fittings and choking, so used for orientation only and not as a golden.

label: ISA-75.01.01 Flow Equations for Sizing Control Valves
notes: Technically identical to IEC 60534-2-1. Would supply the FR curve and the clause 8.2 equations in a text layer, which is what closes the last open item.

label: ISA-RP75.23 Considerations for Evaluating Control Valve Cavitation
notes: Would supply incipient cavitation sigma limits by valve style. Every sigmaIncipient in valve-styles.js is null because no obtained source publishes them, and the tool says so rather than substituting a rule of thumb.
